challenges.name: Time Challenge
challenges.prompt: Complete your first full concept in 30 minutes.

challenges.name: Time Challenge
challenges.prompt: Take the project from blank page to presentable concept in 60 minutes.

challenges.name: Sprint Challenge
challenges.prompt: Ten minutes. Rough layout only — placement and hierarchy, nothing polished.

challenges.name: Deep Work Challenge
challenges.prompt: Two focused hours with no reference sites open.

challenges.name: Colour Challenge
challenges.prompt: Use exactly two colours plus the background.

challenges.name: Monochrome Challenge
challenges.prompt: One hue only. All contrast must come from value.

challenges.name: Distribution Challenge
challenges.prompt: Apply a strict 60 / 30 / 10 colour distribution and be able to point to where each sits.

challenges.name: No Black Challenge
challenges.prompt: No pure black and no pure white anywhere in the composition.

challenges.name: Typography Challenge
challenges.prompt: One typeface only. Weight, size and spacing are your only tools.

challenges.name: Type-Only Challenge
challenges.prompt: No images, no illustration, no icons. Type and shape only.

challenges.name: Scale Challenge
challenges.prompt: Build the whole layout on a single modular scale and document the ratio you used.

challenges.name: Layout Challenge
challenges.prompt: Create an asymmetric layout that still feels balanced.

challenges.name: Grid Challenge
challenges.prompt: Work on a visible 12-column grid and never break it.

challenges.name: Diagonal Challenge
challenges.prompt: Build the composition around one diagonal reading path.

challenges.name: Negative Space Challenge
challenges.prompt: Make empty space the most memorable element in the piece.

challenges.name: Minimalism Challenge
challenges.prompt: Design it, then remove everything that is not doing a job. Keep both versions.

challenges.name: Five Element Challenge
challenges.prompt: A maximum of five visual elements in the entire composition.

challenges.name: Concept Challenge
challenges.prompt: Sketch three distinct thumbnail concepts before developing any of them.

challenges.name: Opposite Challenge
challenges.prompt: Produce your obvious solution, then produce its opposite. Present both.

challenges.name: Rationale Challenge
challenges.prompt: Write a one-sentence rationale before you open your design tool, and hold yourself to it.

challenges.name: Flat Challenge
challenges.prompt: No gradients, shadows or effects of any kind.

challenges.name: Two Size Challenge
challenges.prompt: Only two type sizes are permitted in the whole layout.

challenges.name: Geometry Challenge
challenges.prompt: Every shape you draw must be built from circles and rectangles only.

challenges.name: Small Screen Challenge
challenges.prompt: Design the smallest format first and scale up from it.
